highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews the Skia m158 engine update without changing the managed binding surface.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 while retaining the existing managed wrappers and C API declarations. The milestone update itself retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and reserves the .300 package revision bucket rather than upgrading that engine.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Introduced Skia m158 without managed binding changes. The milestone update retained native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and advanced its package revision to 14.4.0.300.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.
